fod-strip.text: Horizontal three-panel newspaper strip, clean and readable. Consistent cream masthead/header row: left side reads exactly 'The Forces of Darkness, LLC.' in prominent left-aligned type; right side reads exactly 'by Star Splitter Visions' in smaller right-aligned type. Individual strip title is subordinate, positioned under the main title at left. Keep both edges legible with generous padding, never centered or placed over the story panels. CANONICAL MASTER GEOMETRY: 3600 x 1800 pixels overall (2:1 landscape). Reserve an uninterrupted cream masthead across x=0..3599, y=0..299 (300 px, 1/6 of canvas). Below it, arrange precisely THREE separate 1200 x 1500 px panels, each 4:5 portrait: panel 1 crop [x=0,y=300,width=1200,height=1500], panel 2 [x=1200,y=300,width=1200,height=1500], panel 3 [x=2400,y=300,width=1200,height=1500]. Keep all required story art and lettering wholly inside its respective panel. No cross-panel balloons or overlapping panels, no outer gutters between panel crops; draw any borders INSIDE each crop. Preserve crop-safe margins around dialogue and faces, so each panel reads as a standalone mobile portrait image. Derived images consist of the three panel rectangles only, without masthead; add optional mobile branding separately, not over the crop. If generated below the target resolution, preserve the exact 2:1 and three 4:5 proportions during mastering before using these pixel crop coordinates. Bold inked outlines, clean repeatable silhouettes, muted plum/brick/olive/gold palette, simple flat shading, readable deadpan acting, spacious unobstructed speech balloons. Preserve body-size hierarchy (Hork far larger than Eric), established outfits, and exact supplied dialogue and speaker ownership. The evil occupation, dungeon, curses, raids or army infrastructure remains visibly real. Keep a balanced comic rhythm; let the final panel deliver the authored reversal. Each strip stands alone, without invented story continuity.
